body:
Thanks everyone for attending! Between the 2-week cadence and the shortened duration of the meeting (per #8106) we discussed fewer topics than usual. Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8208):

### Agenda

1. Review past action items
    1. Eric will check with Elika about the tests for the [PR for directionality in the shadow DOM](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/7424).
        1. Olli started reviewing and has left a question in the PR.
    1. Emilio will work on a concrete proposal for [Define OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D.font setter in detail](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7847).
        1. No progress.
    1. Mason will draft a PR for [Scoped Custom Element Registries](https://github.com/WICG/webcomponents/issues/716).
        1. Mason is trying to find someone to draft the PR and will bring it up when it's ready.
    1. Domenic will comment on the dialog element [individual blockers](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/4184#issuecomment-1072536425) with his opinion on how blocking/non-blocking they are toward further progress.
        1. [Done](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/4184#issuecomment-1209117993).
    1. Mason will update the group next time with even more test data from the [autocomplete attribute for street-address details](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4986) issue.
        1. Data gathering is ongoing, and we'll revisit this when it's done.
    1. Panos will update the calendar invite with the [new agreed upon times](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8106).
        1. Done.
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. [Emilio] [focus delegate code seems wrongly only looking at children](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8157)
    1. [Emilio] [autofocus + delegateFocus handling doesn't make much sense to me](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8156)
        1. Domenic sent a [PR](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/8174) for both. Unclear if there is test coverage for this. Emilio/Domenic/someone should figure it out.
1. New topics
    1. [Domenic] [Clarify UX (keyboard) and further a11y expectations for modeless dialogs](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7707)
        1. Usage numbers are tempting for deprecation/removal. Will wait to get more experience from the pop-up API before exploring further. Domenic will comment on the thread.

### Action Items

1. Someone else will have to chair the meeting next time. @domenic volunteered.
1. @meyerweb to respond to @smaug----'s review feedback in the [PR for directionality in the shadow DOM](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/7424).
1. @emilio/@domenic/someone should figure out if there is test coverage for [focus delegate code seems wrongly only looking at children](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8157).
1. @domenic will comment on the [Clarify UX (keyboard) and further a11y expectations for modeless dialogs](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7707) thread.
